rule_0_preregistered.prediction: At fore_share=0.45 the stepping struts remove the fixed-plant plow: the run exceeds tick 426, steady fore stance gaps remain in [-1e-6,1e-5] m, swing paws remain airborne, and the support census has at least two contacts at every judged tick.
